## **Annual awards recognize the products reshaping FMCG categories across Western Europe’s largest markets**


**LONDON (OCTOBER 21, 2026)** –NielsenIQ (NYSE: NIQ), a global leader in consumer intelligence, today announced the winners of its **2026 Western Europe NIQ BASES Breakthrough Innovation Awards** , recognizing the most successful and commercially impactful product innovations launched across Great Britain, France, Germany, Italy, and Spain.


Now in its annual Western Europe edition, the NIQ BASES Breakthrough Innovation Awards celebrate products that have demonstrated exceptional market performance, sustained consumer demand, and meaningful category impact. Winners were selected using NIQ’s comprehensive view of innovation performance, leveraging proprietary retail measurement, consumer panel, and BASES innovation analytics to identify launches that achieved strong early success and continued momentum.


This year’s winners reveal an innovation landscape shaped by evolving consumer expectations around health, convenience, premiumization, sustainability, and experience. While breakthrough ideas emerged across a wide range of categories, many of the most successful innovations shared a common characteristic: they reinvented trusted brands for new consumer needs, usage occasions, and market realities.


“Western Europe’s breakthrough innovators prove that growth does not always require creating entirely new categories,” said **Guillaume Biojout, West Europe Innovation Practice Lead** **NIQ** . “This year’s winners did not start from a blank sheet. Most stretched a brand shoppers already trusted into a relevant new need. What set them apart was execution: a product worth buying twice, and an organisation built to move fast.”

Beyond individual successes, NIQ’s analysis identified several recurring innovation strategies among this year’s winners, including brand renovation, premium experiences made more accessible, health-focused product enhancement, and the expansion of established brands into new consumption occasions. These patterns will be explored in greater detail in NIQ’s forthcoming **2026 Western Europe NIQ BASES Breakthrough Innovation Report** .


The Western Europe Breakthrough Innovation Awards are powered by NIQ BASES and draw on NIQ’s combination of retail measurement, consumer panel, innovation measurement, activation, and consumer behavior analytics. Award recipients are selected based on their ability to achieve significant Year 1 sales, maintain momentum over time, and demonstrate meaningful differentiation in their respective categories.


**About the Breakthrough Innovation Awards**


The NIQ BASES Breakthrough Innovation Awards recognize new product launches that achieve exceptional commercial success while delivering meaningful value to consumers and categories. The awards draw on NIQ’s extensive innovation performance databases and proprietary methodologies to identify products that stand out not only for launching successfully, but for sustaining growth and market relevance over time. For more information about the award winners, register to attend the webinar, Lessons from the 2026 West Europe Breakthrough Innovation Winners, on November 4th[here](https://nielseniq.com/global/en/landing-page/bases-breakthrough/)
